name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, friend. It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.

What I'm gonna need from you is the following:

*Incendosaur scales.

*Heavy Leather.

*Coal.

I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.
narrative.offerRewardText: There's always room for more fiery flux, junior. Keep it comin'... unless I tell you to stop.
